slug: 2025-12-01 Nigeria intensifies efforts to digitalise birth, death registrations

facts.fact: DPI Africa reports that the e-CRVS platform launched by President Tinubu 'in November' is a digital platform for documenting birth and stillbirth, birth attestation, adoption, marriage and divorce notification, migration and death, issuing electronic certificates for births and deaths; the document gives no year for the launch (its latest dated figure is August 2023), so its published date is used.
facts.system: electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics System (e-CRVS)

facts.fact: DPI Africa states that the e-CRVS platform is managed by the National Population Commission, the statutory body responsible for documenting births, deaths and marriages; no date is given for this, so the published date is used.
facts.system: electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics System (e-CRVS)

facts.fact: DPI Africa states that birth registration in Nigeria has been paper-based 'over the years' and that the National Population Commission is set to digitalise the process, its chairman calling e-CRVS a departure from paper-based recording of vital events; no date is given, so the published date is used.
facts.system: electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics System (e-CRVS)
